f = 256.0
H = 1.55

def floor_point_to_world(u, v, pose_x, pose_y, heading_deg):
    z_cam = f * H / (v - 256.0)
    x_cam = (u - 256.0) * z_cam / f
    rad = math.radians(heading_deg)
    world_x = pose_x + x_cam * math.cos(rad) + z_cam * math.sin(rad)
    world_y = pose_y - x_cam * math.sin(rad) + z_cam * math.cos(rad)
    return world_x, world_y, z_cam, x_cam

# Front-left leg: u ~ 335
# Front-right leg: u ~ 372
# Back-right leg: behind front-right?
chair_mask = (img[:, :, 2] > 100) & (img[:, :, 2] < 160) & (img[:, :, 0] < 50) & (img[:, :, 1] < 80)
for u in [296, 335, 372]:
    col = img[:, u]
    for v in range(500, 350, -1):

            print(f'Chair leg u={u}, v={v}: world=({wx:.3f}, {wy:.3f}), zc={zc:.3f}')
            break
